name: stripe-customer-transactions-fanout
description: Stripe signed webhooks to transaction and customer Solace topics
assumptions: Stripe sends snapshot event payloads, not thin event notifications.
Events with no customer value are routed under customer id 'unknown'.
Every valid event is published to both stripe/transactions/{event_type} and stripe/customers/{customer_id}/transactions.
Stripe retries can cause duplicate output messages; downstream consumers should deduplicate using stripe_event_id.
